item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"packages/tokens/tokens.json","line":203,"severity":"major","issue":"`--kb-facet-cut` overrides on a skin/consumer wrapper no longer affect cut geometry.","evidence":"`cut-start` and `cut-end` are aliases declared on `:root`, so their `{facet.cut}` references resolve against the root value before inheritance. `facet.css` now uses `--kb-facet-cut-start`/`--kb-facet-cut-end`, bypassing a wrapper's documented `--kb-facet-cut` override; a facet with `data-cut=\"start\"`, `end`, or `both` remains at 0.75rem."}]}
